🧵 PART 10 of 10 — "Tokens With Purpose: The InterLink Protocol Explained"

🚀 The Complete InterLink Vision — All 10 Parts Together

10 parts. 10 concepts.

Today we put it ALL together.

Here's what InterLink is actually building — and why it might be the most important DeFi infrastructure of this decade 👇

The Problem (Part 1): Crypto is detached from real value.
The Solution: Transaction-Backed Digital Assets Protocol.

A system where every real-world transaction AUTOMATICALLY creates demand for a corresponding digital asset.

The Complete Infrastructure Stack:
🔹 InterLinkChain — the settlement blockchain
🔹 Payment SDK — any business can integrate (permissionless)
🔹 InterLink ID — identity for businesses & users
🔹 IRC20 Standard — business tokenization framework
🔹 AMM DEX Layer — automated trading (x*y=k)
🔹 ITL — the reserve & payment currency

The Full 7-Step Cycle:
1. Business integrates InterLink Payment SDK
2. Issues a Business Token (RWA) via IRC20
3. Seeds initial AMM liquidity (BT/ITL pool)
4. Investors buy BT based on transparent metrics
5. Customers pay with ITL → portion auto-swaps for BT
6. More customers = more demand = price reflects real growth
7. Business grows → repeat from step 5 ♾️

Real world impact:
🏪 Lagos business → tokenizes → gets global investment
🚢 Manila shipping → every delivery auto-generates token demand
☕ Jakarta coffee chain → token price grows WITH foot traffic

What makes this DIFFERENT:
❌ Not DeFi speculation — backed by real transactions
❌ Not traditional RWA — fully automated demand via AMM
❌ Not permissioned — any business can join
❌ Not centralized — smart contracts handle everything

✅ The FIRST protocol combining all four.

The InterLink Foundation's thesis:

"Real transaction flow directly drives digital asset demand."

If they pull this off...
We won't talk about crypto as speculation anymore.
We'll talk about it as the infrastructure layer of the global real economy.

That's the vision. 🌍

Share Part 1 with someone who still thinks crypto is all just hype 🔁
